g.text: * Connect endpoint maps users to particular servers.
* Assume 1M connections per server (network optimized instances)
* or 10k servers with 100K connectsion each so that easier to
rebalance shards (rebalancing would need 100K connections all reconnecting)
* Assuming a connection needs a MB of mem - 100k = 100GB of mem.
* Better to go fewer connections and more nodes. 10k connections = 10GB of memory
* Connect server redirects a connection request to the right Conn shard
* Publish server forwards a pub request to the right conn shard
* Both endpoints act as routers to a user shard list - can be like a
shard manager that rebalance when things get hot etc (eg hot groups)
